app.name: Diwali Express Pickup
app.tagline: Licensed green-cracker shops near you. Plan your list, pick a pickup slot, and pay at the shop.

safety.notice: Green crackers only. Burst only between 8 pm and 10 pm on Diwali, as per Supreme Court orders. Keep children supervised.

footer.pay: Prices final at the counter · Pay at the shop

home.step3: Collect and pay at the shop
home.step3Body: Park in the holding bay. The counter scans your list and bills it in seconds.

about.eyebrow: For customers, police and fire officers
about.title: How Diwali Express Pickup works
about.subtitle: A shop finder, price list and drive-through queue for licensed cracker shops in Hyderabad. All buying, packing, billing and payment happen at the licensed counter.

noOnlineSale.title: No online sales
noOnlineSale.body: Customers make a plan list that stays on their own phone. Shops never receive it before the customer is at the counter.

noPayments.title: No payments
noPayments.body: There is no online payment of any kind. Customers pay the shop directly.

noStock.title: No stock, no carrying
noStock.body: Diwali Express Pickup never stores, carries or sends crackers anywhere.

licensed.title: Licensed shops only
licensed.body: Each shop's licence is checked before it is listed. Licence numbers and validity are shown on every shop page, and shops disappear when a licence expires.

green.title: Green crackers only
green.body: Every item carries a CSIR-NEERI green-cracker reference. Joined (series/lari) and barium crackers cannot be listed.

privacy.title: Phone number only
privacy.body: We keep only a phone number, with consent, to hold slots. It is deleted 90 days after the season, or any time on request.

plan.title: Plan
plan.body: Browse a licensed shop's prices and build a list on your phone.

slot.title: Book a slot
slot.body: Pick a 30-minute pickup slot and get a QR ticket.

gate.title: Holding bay
gate.body: A marshal scans the ticket and sends you to a bay away from the stalls.

counter.title: Counter
counter.body: The shop scans your list, bills it, and you pay there.

about.legal: Supreme Court orders (Arjun Gopal v. Union of India, 2018 and 2021) bar online sale of crackers. Diwali Express Pickup is designed so that nothing is ever bought online: the sale is made only at the licensed counter.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: Your account type ({{role}}) cannot open {{area}}. Ask the Diwali Express Pickup team if you need access.
